risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, showing substantial revenue and profitability improvement, stronger liquidity, and continued dividend payments. Key risks include automotive-sector and customer concentration, volatile input costs, pricing pressure, and uncertainty around 2012 demand and margins. Overall tone is cautiously optimistic, with standard forward-looking disclaimers and moderate reliance on qualitative forecasts.
